classification: direct-craft presentation; not population simulation or historical traffic reconstruction

figures.meaning: a generic cloth/load carrier may cross the opening when Buddh is distant, then returns to the left edge as he approaches
a generic basket carrier may cross from the opposite side when the opening is otherwise quiet, then yields back outward

timing.near_clearance: mounted approach begins clearing earlier than foot approach

invariants: no collision, navigation or pathfinding authority
crossing figures never alter the player, horse, save, journal, economy, rank or witness state
at close approach both figures are visually outside the declared central lane
crossing is disabled in caught/ended presentation
traffic rhythm is deliberately sparse and may leave the gate empty
